claims.statement: SettingsWindow is a transient WPF FluentWindow resolved behind a Func<SettingsWindow> factory; the shell builds NavigationViewItems from the SettingsPageCatalog in display order, caches one Page per page id from SettingsPageFactory, animates page transitions and a custom nav indicator, hosts the title-bar Save button and unsaved-changes badge, and registers the SnackbarMessage messenger channel into its SnackbarPresenter.

SettingsPageCatalog is the static navigation source of truth: five registrations (Slots, Plugins, General, Analytics, About) whose registration order equals navigation order, grouped into Workbench (Slots+Plugins) and System (General+Analytics+About); grouping is presentational only, used to insert NavigationViewItemSeparators at group boundaries, and the catalog's default page id is the first registration (Slots).

SettingsPageFactory constructs the five settings pages with their own view-model dependencies (General and Slots share the SettingsViewModel plus IThemeService); unknown page ids throw InvalidOperationException.

SettingsShellViewModel resolves the initial page from ILocalUiPreferencesService.GetLastOpenedSettingsPageId (falling back to the catalog default), rejects unknown page ids in NavigateAsync, consults ISettingsNavigationGuard for user-initiated navigation and window close, and persists the last-opened page id to LocalUiPreferences.json after each successful navigation.

SettingsNavigationGuard is attached to the editor by the SettingsWindow constructor; when the editor has unsaved changes it shows the Save/Don't-Save/Cancel dialog and maps Confirmed to Save (returning false if the save fails), No to DiscardUnsavedChangesAsync (a reload), and Cancel to aborting navigation or close.

SettingsViewModel subscribes to OpenSettingsMessage and on receipt reloads settings (discarding previous unsaved changes), refreshes contexts, selects the requested profile context, and switches to the requested legacy view name; CreateProfileStrategy and the SystemCommandPlugin send this message after ensuring a SettingsWindow is open, making it the decoupled open-and-jump-to-profile path.

LoadSettings runs inside SlotEditorWorkspace.WithSuppressedDirtyAsync: it loads a fresh edit-session draft and persisted secrets, hands both to SlotEditorWorkspace.Load (which rebuilds contexts, selects the first, and resets dirty), then rebinds GeneralSettings, language, theme, and hotkey surfaces; the working draft is exposed through SettingsEditorSession.Draft with an empty fallback config before the first load so bindings have values.

Save() synchronizes the current slot list into the draft (SyncSlotsToConfig), re-refreshes slot parameter metadata, commits pending secrets plus the config draft through SettingsEditorSession.CommitAsync, re-points bound GeneralSettings at the committed draft after any rebase, sends SlotsPerPageChangedMessage so the radial menu re-lays out, rebuilds the hotkey cache from the current config, then resets the dirty flag; on failure it surfaces the first validation error from IConfigService.LastValidationResult or a generic error.

ConfigEditSession is the transactional write path: BeginAsync snapshots the store into a deep-cloned Draft and Base plus the current revision; CommitAsync saves guarded by that revision and on ConfigConcurrencyException rebases untouched regions (Settings, InstalledPresetPacks, and each profile/plugin still equal to the base snapshot) from the store's current values while keeping user-edited regions, then retries once and re-arms the revision so a long-lived editor can save repeatedly.

ConfigService.SaveAsync performs the optimistic-concurrency check inside its write lock, runs the ConfigValidationPipeline (rejecting invalid configs with InvalidOperationException), normalizes plugin configs and switch launch paths, writes a unique temp file, atomically replaces Profiles.json, keeps a rolling .bak of every successful save, and raises ConfigUpdated outside the write lock.

SlotEditorWorkspace.RefreshContexts builds AvailableContexts as Launcher (edits Global.SwitchMode), Global (edits Global.CommandMode), and one context per profile key other than Global (edits that profile's CommandMode); switching context syncs the outgoing list into the config (unless slot sync is suppressed), loads the incoming context's slots ordered by Slot number, rewires per-slot PropertyChanged handlers, and runs inside WithSuppressedDirty so context switching never marks the editor dirty.

Dirty tracking is a single flag: SlotEditorWorkspace.MarkDirty is suppressed by WithSuppressedDirty counts and HasUnsavedChanges is the only source read by the navigation guard, SaveCommand.CanExecute, the title-bar badge, and the close flow; slot collection changes, per-slot property changes, secret staging, and general-settings edits set it, while load, context switching, and draft creation do not.

CreateSlotDraft builds a detached draft (next slot number, plugin icon, metadata/validation/presentation refresh, smart sub-action defaults) that never touches CurrentSlots and never marks dirty; CommitCreatedSlot renumbers, adds to CurrentSlots, marks dirty, and sends SlotAddedMessage. Smart sub-action defaults are injected only in CreateSlotDraft for com.pulsar.command (clipboard catalog) and com.pulsar.system (system tools), so editing or later action changes never re-inject user-owned sub-actions.

SlotListMutator is the single owner of move-and-renumber semantics shared by the settings slot list and the wheel preview: MoveToIndex clamps and renumbers 1..N, and MoveToInsertPosition converts a GongSolutions insert index (measured before removal) into a target index measured after removal; the workspace's Reorder owns the raw insert-index convention for drag-drop.

InitializeSlotMetadata canonicalizes com.pulsar.system actions, falls back to the first declared action when the current one is unknown or empty, and rebuilds the slot's observable projections (AvailableActions, Required/Optional/Advanced parameters, quick-edit parameters, summary tokens) from IPluginMetadataRegistry; validation summaries are derived from LastValidationResult errors whose PropertyName contains ':{slot.Slot}]' for the slot's plugin id, and severity always comes from the validation record rather than message text.

SlotEditorViewModel is the wizard dialog view-model for slot authoring (create and edit modes): a picker phase over SlotTypeCard primary/browse catalogs and a configuration phase with action selector, grouped parameter fields, appearance, and a Sub-Actions section; Save runs blocking validation (type, action, required parameters), queues a focus request on the first invalid field, materializes sub-actions, and requests close, while CanCloseAsync(Confirmed) blocks closing while a blocking issue exists.

Sub-actions are edited as SubSlotEditorRow observable wrappers over the immutable SubSlotDescriptor record: each row shares its working Args dictionary with a backing PluginSlot so parameter-field indexer reads/writes operate on the same dictionary the descriptor is materialized from on save; MaterializeSubActions writes Slot.SubActions (null when empty) and persists CascadeLayoutStyle only for a non-default Ring choice.

PluginSlot serializes subActions and layoutStyle with JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull so absent keys stay byte-compatible with legacy profiles, and deserialization tolerates absent/null keys by reading them as empty sub-action lists.

SlotEditorWorkspace stages secrets in PendingSecrets (mutated in place by the secret picker and QuickSecretsViewModel), tracks persisted secrets separately, and supports ResolveSecretDisplay via IPkiSecretMetadataResolver against both maps; Save merges PendingSecrets into the secret store before committing the config, and ReplacePersistedSecrets adopts the merged map as the new baseline.

SettingsSlotsPage hosts the context switcher and profile actions, an empty state, and the SlotWheelEditor control; it resolves the container-registered SlotWheelEditorViewModel, syncs it to the current context and SlotsPerPage on load and on CurrentSlots/CurrentContext/GeneralSettings changes, re-hooks GeneralSettings for immediate RefreshLayout on SlotsPerPage edits, and routes wheel EditRequested/DeleteRequested/AddSlotRequested to OpenSlotConfiguration, RemoveSlot, and AddSlotDialogCommand.

SlotWheelEditorViewModel paginates the shared slot list (clamping SlotsPerPage to 1-60), computes ring layout through ISlotLayoutEngine (center (250,250), base radius 90), builds one WheelSlotItem per ring position with placeholders padding the last page, hit-tests drops via TryResolveDropPosition (rejecting the dead zone and out-of-range positions), reorders with renumbering, moves across pages via MoveToPageAndSlot, and flashes the newly added slot for 2 seconds on SlotAddedMessage.

SlotWheelEditor implements the wheel's drag interactions (threshold-based drag ghost, drop-target highlight, mouse-up reorder through the view-model hit test, click-to-edit, hover edit/delete buttons, Ctrl+Left/Right keyboard reorder, Enter to edit, Delete to remove) and raises AddSlotRequested when a placeholder slot is clicked.

SettingsViewModel.General binds the General page: CurrentTheme writes Settings.Theme and applies it immediately through IThemeService (dispatcher-safe), RendererStyle/ThemePreset persist RadialRenderer/RadialThemePreset, ShowGridHotkey/ShowSwitcherHotkey apply and validate hotkeys live, SelectedLogLevel applies the minimum log level via ILoggingConfigService, and RendererOptions enumerates built-in plus plugin-contributed radial renderers through StyleRendererFactory on every settings open; theme reconciliation is bidirectional via SyncThemeFromService from the tray
